items.example: I lost my job, but now I can travel. Every cloud, eh?
items.exampleTr: İşimi kaybettim ama artık seyahat edebilirim. Her işte bir hayır var, değil mi?
items.simple: Short way to say: even a bad thing can bring something good.
dialogue: A: The flight's cancelled, but they gave us a free hotel.
B: Well, every cloud, eh?
items.note: Tamamı: 'Every cloud has a silver lining.' Konuşmada çoğu zaman yarım bırakılır.

items.example: I don't love my job, but better the devil you know.
items.exampleTr: İşimi çok sevmiyorum ama bildiğin şeytan bilmediğin melekten iyidir.
items.simple: Something you know, even if not great, is safer than something new.
dialogue: A: Why don't you switch to the other internet company?
B: Nah, better the devil you know.
items.note: Değişiklikten kaçınırken; Türkçe karşılığıyla birebir.

items.example: Everyone eats with their hands here, so when in Rome!
items.exampleTr: Burada herkes elle yiyor, eh, Roma'da Romalı gibi!
items.simple: In a new place, do what the local people do.
dialogue: A: Dinner at ten o'clock at night?
B: It's Spain. When in Rome!
items.note: Tamamı: 'When in Rome, do as the Romans do.' Tatilde çok kullanılır.

items.example: Five people editing one document? Too many cooks.
items.exampleTr: Bir belgeyi beş kişi mi düzenliyor? Fazla aşçı yemeği bozar.
items.simple: When too many people work on one thing, they spoil it.
dialogue: A: Shall I help you two with the cooking?
B: No thanks, too many cooks.
items.note: Tamamı: 'Too many cooks spoil the broth.'

items.example: You haven't got the job yet, so don't count your chickens.
items.exampleTr: İşi daha almadın, dereyi görmeden paçaları sıvama.
items.simple: Don't be sure of a good thing before it really happens.
dialogue: A: Once I win the lottery, I'm buying a boat.
B: Don't count your chickens!
items.note: Tamamı: '...before they hatch.' Genelde yarım söylenir.

items.tr: Dilenciye hıyar vermişler, eğri diye beğenmemiş.
items.example: It's not my dream flat, but beggars can't be choosers.
items.exampleTr: Hayalimdeki daire değil ama seçici olacak durumda değilim.
items.simple: If you need help, you can't be picky about what you get.
dialogue: A: There's only decaf left.
B: Beggars can't be choosers. I'll take it.
items.note: Kendi durumun için alçakgönüllü söylenir; başkasına söylemek kaba olabilir.

items.example: Don't just blame him for the fight. It takes two to tango.
items.exampleTr: Kavga için sadece onu suçlama. Tek elden ses çıkmaz.
items.simple: When two people have a problem, both of them helped make it.
dialogue: A: She started the argument!
B: Come on, it takes two to tango.
items.note: Kavga ya da ilişki sorunlarında tek tarafı suçlamamak için.

items.example: Everyone's saying he cheated. No smoke without fire.
items.exampleTr: Herkes onun aldattığını söylüyor. Ateş olmayan yerden duman çıkmaz.
items.simple: If people talk about it, there's probably some truth in it.
dialogue: A: They say the boss is selling the company.
B: Well, no smoke without fire.
items.note: Tamamı: 'There's no smoke without fire.' Dedikoduya inanırken.

items.en: You can't have your cake and eat it.
items.example: You want a big house and no mortgage? You can't have your cake and eat it.
items.exampleTr: Hem büyük ev hem kredisiz mi? Hem dağdan hem bağdan olmaz.
items.simple: You can't have two good things when they don't go together.
dialogue: A: I want to work less but earn more.
B: You can't have your cake and eat it.
items.note: Konuşmada 'You can't have it both ways' ile aynı anlam.

items.example: Everyone thinks city life is better. The grass is always greener.
items.exampleTr: Herkes şehir hayatını daha iyi sanıyor. Komşunun tavuğu komşuya kaz görünür.
items.simple: Other people's lives always look better than yours, but often aren't.
dialogue: A: I wish I had Jake's job.
B: The grass is always greener, mate.
items.note: Tamamı: '...on the other side (of the fence).' Çoğu zaman yarım bırakılır.

items.en: Rome wasn't built in a day.
items.example: You've only been learning for a month. Rome wasn't built in a day.
items.exampleTr: Daha bir aydır öğreniyorsun. Roma bir günde kurulmadı.
items.simple: Big things take a long time, so be patient.
dialogue: A: I've been to the gym twice and I still look the same.
B: Give it time. Rome wasn't built in a day.
items.note: Sabırsız birini cesaretlendirirken.

items.en: If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
items.example: Why change the menu? If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
items.exampleTr: Menüyü neden değiştiriyorsunuz? Çalışan şeyi kurcalama.
items.simple: If something works fine, don't try to change it.
dialogue: A: Should we redesign the website?
B: Why? If it ain't broke, don't fix it.
items.note: 'ain't' bilerek yanlış, gayriresmî; sabit kalıp böyle.

items.example: I still check my work emails on holiday. Old habits die hard.
items.exampleTr: Tatilde hâlâ iş e-postalarımı kontrol ediyorum. Eski alışkanlıklar kolay bırakılmaz.
items.simple: Things you always did are very hard to stop doing.
dialogue: A: You're retired! Why are you up at six?
B: Old habits die hard.
items.note: Kendine ya da başkasına hafif hoşgörüyle.

items.en: Two wrongs don't make a right.
items.example: He was rude first, I know, but two wrongs don't make a right.
items.exampleTr: İlk o kabalık etti, biliyorum, ama kötülüğe kötülükle karşılık verilmez.
items.simple: If someone does a bad thing, doing a bad thing back is still bad.
dialogue: A: He ate my lunch, so I'm eating his.
B: Two wrongs don't make a right.
items.note: Çocuklara ve intikam isteyenlere çok söylenir.

items.example: I hate the bus, but my car's broken, so needs must.
items.exampleTr: Otobüsten nefret ediyorum ama arabam bozuk, mecburen.
items.simple: You have to do it, even if you don't want to.
dialogue: A: You're working on a Sunday?
B: Needs must. The rent's due.
items.note: İngiliz İngilizcesi; tamamı: 'Needs must when the devil drives.'

items.example: I don't want to know how much the wedding cost. Ignorance is bliss.
items.exampleTr: Düğünün kaça mal olduğunu bilmek istemiyorum. Bilmemek en iyisi.
items.simple: Sometimes not knowing about a problem makes you happier.
dialogue: A: Do you want to know what's in that sausage?
B: No. Ignorance is bliss.
items.note: Kötü haberi duymak istemezken esprili.

items.example: I paid the full price and saw it half off the next day. Live and learn.
items.exampleTr: Tam fiyat ödedim, ertesi gün yarı fiyata gördüm. Ders oldu.
items.simple: You made a mistake, but now you know better.
dialogue: A: You bought shoes online without checking the size?
B: I know. Live and learn.
items.note: Küçük bir hatadan sonra kendini teselli ederken.

items.example: He cheated on everyone, and now he's been dumped. What goes around comes around.
items.exampleTr: Herkesi aldattı, şimdi de terk edildi. Ne ekersen onu biçersin.
items.simple: If you do bad things, bad things will come back to you.
dialogue: A: The guy who stole my parking spot just got a ticket.
B: Ha! What goes around comes around.
items.note: Karma fikri; genelde biri hak ettiğini bulunca.

items.en: don't put all your eggs in one basket
items.example: Apply for a few jobs, don't put all your eggs in one basket.
items.exampleTr: Birkaç işe başvur, bütün yumurtaları aynı sepete koyma.
items.simple: Don't trust only one plan; have other plans too.
dialogue: A: I'm only applying to one university.
B: Don't put all your eggs in one basket.
items.note: Para, iş, başvuru konularında tavsiye.

items.en: Absence makes the heart grow fonder.
items.example: We only see each other at weekends, but absence makes the heart grow fonder.
items.exampleTr: Sadece hafta sonları görüşüyoruz ama uzaklık sevgiyi artırır.
items.simple: When you're far from someone you love, you miss them and love them more.
dialogue: A: Aren't you sad he's away for a month?
B: A bit, but absence makes the heart grow fonder.
items.note: Uzak mesafe ilişkilerinde; şakayla tersini de söyleyenler olur.

items.en: out of sight, out of mind
items.tr: gözden ırak olan gönülden de ırak olur
items.example: I keep the biscuits in the top cupboard. Out of sight, out of mind.
items.exampleTr: Bisküvileri üst dolapta tutuyorum. Gözden ırak, gönülden ırak.
items.simple: When you can't see something, you forget about it.
dialogue: A: Have you heard from your old school friends?
B: Not really. Out of sight, out of mind.
items.note: Hem ilişkiler hem alışkanlıklar için.

items.en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
items.example: It's a free upgrade. Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
items.exampleTr: Bedava yükseltme bu. Bahşiş atın dişine bakılmaz.
items.simple: If you get something free, don't complain about it.
dialogue: A: Why would they give us free tickets? It's weird.
B: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.
items.note: Türkçe karşılığıyla neredeyse birebir.

items.tr: tencere yuvarlanmış kapağını bulmuş, benzer benzerini bulur
items.example: Both of them are always late. Birds of a feather.
items.exampleTr: İkisi de hep geç kalıyor. Tencere yuvarlanmış kapağını bulmuş.
items.simple: People who are alike like to be together.
dialogue: A: Tom and his new girlfriend both love conspiracy theories.
B: Birds of a feather, eh?
items.note: Tamamı: '...flock together.' Konuşmada yarım bırakılır.

items.example: He puts ketchup on everything. Each to their own.
items.exampleTr: Her şeye ketçap koyuyor. Herkesin zevki kendine.
items.simple: Different people like different things, and that's OK.
dialogue: A: My neighbour has forty garden gnomes.
B: Each to their own, I suppose.
items.note: Eski hali 'each to his own'; ABD'de 'to each their own'.

items.example: I won fifty quid and lost it the same night. Easy come, easy go.
items.exampleTr: Elli pound kazandım, aynı gece kaybettim. Haydan gelen huya gider.
items.simple: Things you got easily, you can lose easily, so don't be sad.
dialogue: A: You lost the money you found on the street?
B: Yep. Easy come, easy go.
items.note: Kayba umursamazca bakarken.

items.en: A leopard can't change its spots.
items.example: He says he's changed, but a leopard can't change its spots.
items.exampleTr: Değiştiğini söylüyor ama huylu huyundan vazgeçmez.
items.simple: People don't really change who they are.
dialogue: A: He promised he'd stop lying.
B: A leopard can't change its spots.
items.note: Genelde eski sevgili veya güvenilmez biri hakkında.
